title: Stacked head, the quarter
summary: The approved h1 at 96px with its whole second line light, an idea kicker, a one-line lede in cols 7–12 that says who the layer is for, and a measure plate: one quarter drawn to scale as three lanes on thirteen weeks — the weekly review, win/loss interviews as deals close, and the week-13 readout — redrawn for tablets (no label gutter) and phones, each frame carrying its own labels and '13 weeks'.

reference.site: GoNimbly's gantt-like home band (founder's screenshot) on the approved interior header X
reference.borrowed: A plan drawn as bars on a ruled grid, directly under the head, labelled with a few large sentence-case words.
reference.kelwin: A real unit (13 weeks) and real cadence instead of an orbit metaphor; one red block, kit drawing weights, flat graphite.

motion: entrance: the h1 writes itself in (kit §13), the rule and lede rise, the plate rises and widens; the drawing has no beat of its own.
notes: Round 9 fix: the lede no longer previews the four questions (it has a different job); the kicker no longer echoes the homepage ('what the signal says'); the plate is the page's one statement of the cadence; below 1024 the drawing carries its labels and its unit, so the figcaption is screen-reader only (no caption-plus-key repeat); the section clips its own x-overflow on phones.
